name: nexus
description: Connects Claude to Nexus Commerce (catalog, listings, content, ids, prices, stock, suppliers, orders, returns, ads, automations) for one business per connection, and adds 22 skills, from a weekly channel health check to change plans and undo. Claude reads and asks for changes; each change waits for a person's approval in Nexus unless the business set that change to run by its rule or to be confirmed with an authenticator code.
